name: coll_col_d64_a-d2-COMMIT
purpose: Qwen TP8 collective engine column leaf, DEPTH 64 (qwen-coll-io 10-14, el1014-qwen-coll-io.log). Composition bench: 8-rank TP8 golden through ot_coll_tp8_die WT 3 (DEPTH 64 engine of 5 of these leaves); mutants OT_ONESHOT_M_MEMM_MUTANT (leaf reads the next slot) and OT_ONESHOT_M_MUTANT (package ranks 1/2 swapped) fail.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_coll_col_tile_d64 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/rom/ot_coll_col_tile_d64.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/coll_col_d64_a/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/coll_col_d64_a/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/coll_col_d64_a --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_coll_col_tile_d64 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_32x128_m1 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: Native pin audit of the CLOSED d1 view (coll_col_d64_a-d1-227248fe1, TT R 227.5, phi - R, first-load Liberty; results/rtl/qwen_coll_io_1014/native_audit/ot_coll_col_tile_d64.json): launch 280.2 (tx 50/128 > 220: tx <= hq and lpq <= hq are equal registers merged into one flop that also feeds the FIFO write mux, so it sits inside) and capture 255.9 (c_l1 14, c_wp 12, c_gidx 2, rank_oh 3, c_push 2, rx_d 7, in_d 2), 96 pins over 220/190. d2 = same RTL, same outline / pin faces / macro plan, kit recipe 2 (io_flop_at_pins: every pin flop FIRM at its pin; pin_reg_split: one dedicated launch flop per output pin; keep_pin_regs; HB2 pin pads; recipe hold margin 30 ps) with the closed kit's halo 6.48. Benches move to the WT 3 production structure (--wrapper-columns 3).

reroute_reason.fix: kit recipe 2: every RTL pin flop FIRM at its pin (io_flop_at_pins), one dedicated launch flop per output pin (pin_reg_split: tx and lpq are equal registers of hq that synthesis merged, so the tx pin flop could not sit at its pin), pin registers kept through synthesis, HB2 pin hold pads; the recipe-1 d1 kit had only leaf_inhold and let GPL pull c_l1/c_wp/c_gidx/rank_oh/c_push capture flops toward the macros
